email_multiplicity_exception.eligible: Exactly one distinct submission-email destination passes the complete frozen gate AND every alternative candidate is positively role mismatched.
blocked: Any insufficient, failed, unprocessed or otherwise unclassified alternative
Two or more matched submission destinations
Any independent hard blocker on the surviving destination
email_multiplicity_exception.implementation_status: verified final READY code and passing offline checks

cross_channel_policy.missing_evidence: No candidate in a channel permits recovery from the other supported channel; never proof of absence.
cross_channel_policy.conservative_primary_rule: When fallback exists, ANY unresolved candidate for a field in either channel blocks terminal acceptance for that field, including same-value and null-normalized candidates. Only a completed positively mismatched role can be ignored. Incompatible supported values also block.
cross_channel_policy.raw_evidence: Retain raw_literal for every candidate result.
cross_channel_policy.terminal_status_consistency: A terminal review downgrade updates shadow_status, disposition and action_readiness consistently; provider results remain immutable provisional evidence.
cross_channel_policy.implementation_status: verified final READY code and passing focused offline checks
